name: @treeseed/market
description: TreeSeed marketplace site built on top of @treeseed/core.

scripts.bootstrap: if test -f ./packages/core/scripts/workspace-bootstrap.ts; then node ./packages/core/scripts/run-ts.mjs ./packages/core/scripts/workspace-bootstrap.ts; elif test -f ./node_modules/@treeseed/core/dist/scripts/workspace-bootstrap.js; then node ./node_modules/@treeseed/core/dist/scripts/workspace-bootstrap.js; else treeseed starlight:patch; fi
scripts.dev:web: if test -f ./packages/core/scripts/dev-platform.ts; then node ./packages/core/scripts/run-ts.mjs ./packages/core/scripts/dev-platform.ts --surface web; elif test -f ./node_modules/@treeseed/core/dist/scripts/dev-platform.js; then node ./node_modules/@treeseed/core/dist/scripts/dev-platform.js --surface web; else echo 'Unable to resolve @treeseed/core dev-platform entrypoint.'; exit 1; fi
scripts.dev:api: if test -f ./packages/core/scripts/dev-platform.ts; then node ./packages/core/scripts/run-ts.mjs ./packages/core/scripts/dev-platform.ts --surface api; elif test -f ./node_modules/@treeseed/core/dist/scripts/dev-platform.js; then node ./node_modules/@treeseed/core/dist/scripts/dev-platform.js --surface api; else echo 'Unable to resolve @treeseed/core dev-platform entrypoint.'; exit 1; fi
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.verify:direct: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run build
